svg.aria-label: Where state lives, as a decision ladder. Must another device or person see it: the server. Should refresh or a shared link reproduce it: the URL. Do far-apart parts of the page need it at the same moment: a shared store. Otherwise: component memory. Keeping one fact in two homes causes drift.
svg.text: WHERE DOES THIS STATE LIVE · FIRST YES WINS
